## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Explain skipped or unavailable checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope, input, and execution boundaries are preserved or changes are explained.
- [ ] Functional changes cover meaningful success, failure, and recovery behavior.
- [ ] UI mode labels and evidence provenance remain accurate.
- [ ] Documentation matches the final implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime snapshots, generated downloads, or private data are included.
